hits.title: iRhythm to acquire VitalConnect to build cardiac monitoring platform for hospital-to-home care.
hits.snippet: Moving on to bridge this continuum of care gap from acute hospital beds to distant home settings, pioneering digital healthcare company, iRhythm Holdings, Inc., has announced a definitive agreement to acquire VitalConnect, Inc., the pioneer in wearable biosensors and remote patient monitoring, in a deal valued at approximately $287.5 million.

hits.title: Heart monitoring patch maker VitalConnect raises $100M
hits.snippet: The wearable cardiac monitor maker VitalConnect has raised $100 million in new capital to aid in the development of its in-hospital wireless patient trackers while also expanding its commercial efforts.

hits.snippet: VitalConnect, a developer of wearable biosensor technology, has secured more than $30 million in a Series F led by Revelation Partners.

hits.snippet: VitalConnect secures over $30 million in oversubscribed Series F financing.

hits.title: Frost & Sullivan Recognizes VitalConnect with the 2022 New Product Innovation Award for Its Leading-edge Wearable Patient Monitoring Device
hits.snippet: SAN ANTONIO, Texas, Dec. 12, 2022 /CNW/ -- Based on its recent analysis of the wearable biosensor industry, Frost & Sullivan recognizes VitalConnect with the 2022 North America New Product Innovation Award for delivering a world-class biosensor that comfortably monitors patients and detects multiple health problems.
